title: Senior Product Owner - App, UI/UX
summary: led the strategy, roadmap, and UI/UX design of the company's digital applications, from user research and prototyping through release management.
fullDescription: As Senior Product Owner at Elemental North America,I led the strategy, roadmap, and UI/UX design of the company's digital applications, from user research and prototyping through release management, while working closely with developers, project managers, and business leaders to keep the products aligned with company goals. I also served as the main point of contact for application issues, enhancements, and strategic planning, using performance data and user feedback to drive continuous improvement for over 42,000 app users. I also used AI to build internal operational tools outside the main application suite, including a production dashboard that tracked receiving inventory, processed material, and lab analysis formulas to calculate raw material extraction and client payments
responsibilities: Owned the vision, roadmap, and lifecycle management of Company applications.
Led UI/UX design initiatives, including user research, wireframing, prototyping, usability testing, and design validation.
Defined user journeys, workflows, and interface standards to ensure consistency across applications.
Monitored application performance, user feedback, and analytics to identify opportunities for improvement.
Built out the development team's operational infrastructure, including a Jira-based agile ticketing and UAT process, release notes as part of every release, and daily standups.

title: Senior Product Owner
summary: Led end-to-end program execution for hardware-software subsystems on ICON's large-scale 3D construction printing platform, coordinating embedded firmware, software, and mechanical engineering teams to ship the Titan 3D printer, print pump, and BuildOS software.
fullDescription: As Senior Product Owner at ICON, I led end-to-end program execution for hardware-software subsystems across the Titan 3D printer, print pump, and BuildOS software platform, coordinating closely with embedded firmware, software, and mechanical engineering teams.

I defined system-level acceptance criteria for hardware-software integration testing, maintained risk registers, and drove mitigation planning to keep programs on track. I also served as the escalation point for schedule and scope conflicts between engineering and operations.
responsibilities: Defined system-level acceptance criteria for hardware-software integration testing
Maintained risk registers and drove mitigation planning across engineering teams
Served as escalation point for schedule and scope conflicts
Coordinated cross-functional execution across embedded firmware, software, and mechanical engineering

title: Product Owner
summary: Owned the product roadmap for SISU's custom robotics systems, defining features and requirements for mechanical and software engineering teams building automation for clients including Tesla, Applied Materials, KUKA, and Napa.
fullDescription: As Product Owner at SISU Custom Robotics, I owned and executed the product roadmap for custom robotics systems, defining features and product requirements for mechanical and software engineering teams.

Beyond roadmap ownership, I served as scrum master (daily standups, design reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement) and oversaw manufacturing, New Product Introduction (NPI), procurement, and inventory management across multiple concurrent project roadmaps for clients including Tesla, Applied Materials, KUKA, and Napa.
responsibilities: Owned and executed the product roadmap, prioritizing against stakeholder needs and business strategy
Ran scrum ceremonies: daily standups, design reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement
Oversaw manufacturing, NPI, procurement, and inventory management
Managed multiple concurrent project roadmaps simultaneously

title: Operations Manager
summary: Managed operations for Moxi, Diligent Robotics' hospital service robot, expanding deployments beyond Texas and leading facility mapping, acceptance testing, and cross-functional planning for clinical robotic rollouts.
fullDescription: As Operations Manager at Diligent Robotics, I worked as a healthcare partner collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop strategic plans and roadmaps for clinical robotic deployments of Moxi, the hospital service robot.

I led the expansion of operations beyond Texas, overseeing daily operations and project management, and developed standard operating procedures and knowledge bases for team onboarding. I coordinated implementation projects including facility mapping and acceptance testing, and conducted user research and analyzed product system logs to identify stakeholder pain points.
responsibilities: Expanded operations beyond Texas, overseeing daily operations and project management
Developed SOPs and knowledge bases for team onboarding
Coordinated implementation projects: facility mapping and acceptance testing
Conducted user research and analyzed system logs to identify stakeholder pain points
Managed product redesign, QA validation, SLAM testing, and A/B testing

title: On-Site Client Support Specialist
summary: Supported Karl Storz's flagship clinical account in Texas — the largest in the US — onboarding new medical devices and surgical robotics systems and educating clinical staff on da Vinci and other cutting-edge equipment.
fullDescription: As On-Site Client Support Specialist at Karl Storz United States, I enhanced operational processes, supported customers, onboarded new products, and educated clinical staff on cutting-edge medical devices and surgical robotics systems.

I developed process improvement strategies to optimize efficiency and reduce costs, managed onboarding for new products in clinical environments, and launched the flagship and largest clinical support account in Texas for Karl Storz in the US.
responsibilities: Developed process improvement strategies to optimize efficiency and reduce costs
Managed onboarding for new products in clinical environments
Educated clinical staff on medical devices and surgical robotics systems, including da Vinci
Launched the flagship and largest clinical support account in Texas for Karl Storz in the US
